properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The non-cryptographic PRNG half of the randomness inventory. The C rating stands for the class; the recorded nuance is that no secret material flows from math/rand — all secrets draw from crypto/rand (ALG-80605930). The puppeth time-seeded outputs (workdir names, default chain ID) are predictable but not credentials.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CTR without AEAD at each site is intentional but MAC-dependent: keystore v3 authenticates via the keccak 'mac' field, ECIES via HMAC-SHA256, RLPx via the keccak egress/ingress MAC — a MAC is applied separately at every production site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The account/transaction signing keypair: ecdsa.GenerateKey over secp256k1 (crypto.S256()) in key.go, crypto.go, and the secp256k1 test. Migration target ML-DSA/SLH-DSA family for future signing, but secp256k1 is fixed by the Ethereum protocol here — observable, replaceable only by a protocol fork.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Legacy presale-wallet at-rest format: PBKDF2 (2000 iters, password-as-salt) → AES-128, CTR for the key half then CBC for the rest. Malleable without the keccak MAC, but it is a read-only legacy import path.

components.name: Go crypto/tls sessions on default settings (Go 1.9)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: TLS/HTTPS clients on Go 1.9 defaults: x25519 is the first-offered group, no PQ option exists in Go 1.9; harvestable now. Changeable by bumping the toolchain (Go 1.24+ defaults to X25519MLKEM768) and, for peers that support it, TLS 1.3.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 iteration counts (relevant to CWE-916): presale 2000, wnode 4096, whisper 65356, keystore v3 c from wallet JSON — the low presale/wnode counts are the notable weakness on this asset.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 sites: keystore v3 default wallet encryption; ECIES AES-128-SHA256 parameter set for secp256k1 and P256. AES-128 is not broken, but CNSA 2.0 requires AES-256; quantum margin halves under Grover.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Whisper v5/v6 payload AEAD: aes.NewCipher → cipher.NewGCM → Seal with a fresh random nonce on encrypt, Open on decrypt; key is keccak-derived per message.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keystore v3 password KDF (default): scrypt N=2^18, r=8, p=1, dkLen=32 (constants at keystore_passphrase.go:67-69). The JSON vectors and keyHeaderKDF constant document the same live on-disk wallet format.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live AES per site: presale AES-128 (CTR then CBC) on a PBKDF2 key; RLPx p2p framing AES-128-CTR keyed with s.AES plus the MAC-seeding cipher keyed with s.MAC; whisper v5/v6 AES-256-GCM (32-byte keccak-derived key).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The codebase's CSPRNG: crypto/rand backs keystore salt/IV generation, account key generation, ethash mining nonce, RLPx handshake, whisper message nonces. Includes the meitu fork's crypto/randentropy wrapper used by the keystore, itself reading crypto/rand. No weakness; kept for completeness of the PRNG inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: puppeth deployment tooling authenticates to remote hosts with the operator's SSH key (plain or passphrase-protected); feeds the x/crypto/ssh session at ssh.go:141. Changeable here.

components.name: Go x/crypto/ssh sessions on default settings (golang.org/x/crypto version unknown)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: puppeth SSH sessions to deployment hosts. PQ status: definitively NO — the vendored x/crypto/ssh (vendor/golang.org/x/crypto/ssh/common.go:35-40) has no post-quantum KEX. Changeable by bumping the vendored library.
